# Psychotherapy Denis Kotnik

> English-language website for Denis Kotnik’s psychodynamic psychotherapy practice, offering sessions online and in Leeuwarden.

The website introduces Denis Kotnik’s psychotherapy practice, areas of support, professional background, and answers to common questions about psychodynamic psychotherapy.

## Main pages

- [Psychotherapy Denis Kotnik](https://psychotherapy-kotnik.com/): Overview of the practice, areas of support, therapist, and contact options.
- [About psychotherapy](https://psychotherapy-kotnik.com/about-psychotherapy): Information about psychodynamic psychotherapy, the therapeutic process, common questions, and evidence for its effectiveness.

## Additional resources

- [Slovenian website](https://psihoterapija-kotnik.si/): Slovenian-language version of the website.
- [Sitemap](https://psychotherapy-kotnik.com/sitemap.xml): List of public pages on this website.

The information on this website is general and is not a substitute for an individual professional assessment, diagnosis, or emergency assistance.
